events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Still got it after all these years! Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released on October 1, 1975. The song was originally released in the US in 1971, then as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Released today in 1975, John Lennon's 'Imagine' gave us a timeless anthem for peace and hope. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: The first-generation Apple iPod, which revolutionised portable music listening, was announced on October 23, 2001, and released on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket felt like magic? It was 2001 when Apple first dropped the iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which 007 film or song is your ultimate favourite? Licence to thrill us with your choices!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of humour has given us countless classic moments. What's your favourite Cleese character?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Blank Canvas of Genius
angles.copy: Released today in 1968, The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' pushed boundaries and showcased their diverse genius. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Forever A Champion
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and spirit remain unmatched. Forever a champion.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: A Soulful Evolution
angles.copy: Released today in 1965, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' showcased their incredible evolution, blending folk, pop, and soul. Which track from this classic album is always on your playlist?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an influential solo artist, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a musical giant. We remember John Lennon, whose legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.
